svg.title: SeriesPack striped residuals, R = 1 through 7
svg.desc: Each colored cell names a value bit from a 32-row group. Each grid row is one byte lane of a 32-byte stripe. Columns are stored-byte bits zero through seven. The exact v1 maps are generated from tail_bit<R>.

g.text: One byte lane shown · each row is a 32-byte stripe · stored bits run 0 → 7
For lane l, A…H mean rows l, 32+l, …, 224+l. Byte offset = 32s+l. Sizes shown are tail-only.
